name: Debugger
description: Remote Python debugging over DAP (Debug Adapter Protocol) — breakpoints, stepping, stack/scope/variable inspection, exception interception — against debugpy sessions exposed by a DAP server. Ports agentic-workspace's aw-debugger MCP (src/mcp/debugger.py) AS-IS: same DAPClient, same 17 tools, same behavior. Preservation port, not evolved — see README for the known dead-code paths and the monolith-only integrations that quietly no-op here.

skills.description: Remote Python debugging over DAP through this app's aw-debugger MCP server — the 17 tools, the minimal connect → breakpoint → continue → stack/variables flow, and an explicit warning that this port has never been exercised against a live debugpy session.

default_host.description: Host of the DAP server this MCP talks to (agentic-workspace's dap-server, a debugpy multiplexer). Not ported here — this app is the MCP client only. Same default as the monolith's hardcoded value.

default_port.description: Port of the DAP server this MCP talks to. Same default as the monolith's hardcoded value (15050).

apps.reason: This app writes its own mcp.json (the 'debugger' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach its tools.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan debugger/mcp.json.
